notes.title: The RUNNER UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]NEW FEATURES![/b]

- New Weapons added , a sub-machine-gun , assault rifle , semi-automatic shotgun and a machete.

- New UI features.

- New Songs and in-Game Sounds.

- New options: mouse sensitivity and screen options.

- Checkpoints in some levels.

- New animations.

We hope you like it! let us know what you think of this update.

notes.title: Time Break 2121 V.1.2 Is Here !
notes.content:
The Game Has new features !

-If jumping and dodging is not your thing and you just want to shoot and stab bad guys The Cybernetic levels are now Skippable.

-Tweaks in the animations.

-New Model for the arms

-The Die screen now replay the level automatically 

-Stab tweaks

-Menu bugs fixed.

-A new Field Of View that will make your experience more immersive.

-UI Changes, a cleaner Hud for the game.

-The Blur that happened in the game it's now gone.

-The enemy's now dissapear faster.

-In-game bug fixes.

Stay Tuned for more Updates with even more features!

notes.title: Time Break is Now Live! And we are commited to make the game the best version it can be
notes.content:
Time Break is Now Live! And we are commited to make the game the best it can be.


Soon we will be updating the game with new features. The first one is going live this week, it's a complete makeover of the menus, making them more intuitive and better for the user, we hope you like it!
